description: You are using Aerobridge, an open-source drone/UAV fleet management system. Your task is to add a new pilot to the personnel registry. Navigate to http://localhost:8000/admin/registry/pilot/add/ (log in as 'admin' / 'adminpass123' if needed). The Pilot form has a 'Person' field — click the green '+' button next to it to create a new Person in a popup. In the Person popup, fill in: (1) First Name: 'Aditya', (2) Last Name: 'Kumar', (3) Email: 'aditya.kumar@droneops.in', (4) Phone number: any valid phone (e.g. '+919876543210'), (5) Documents: click 'Default Aerobridge Document' in the list to select it. Save the Person (click SAVE in the popup). Back in the Pilot form, fill in the remaining required fields: (6) Operator: select any available operator from the dropdown (e.g. 'A.J. August Photography'), (7) Address: select any available address from the dropdown, (8) Documents: click 'Default Aerobridge Document' to select it. Click Save to register the pilot. Do not log out after saving.
